## The range, and the arithmetic, and the one thing you may not assume

**Volume 08 is fifty chapters on fifty days, days 351 to 400, one chapter to one day, and it is finished. The eighty-fifth day of the Bare Month was day 400, a Tuesday, and it is the last day of that month any chapter of this volume printed, and no chapter printed a day after it.**

**RECOMOMPUTE THE FIFTY DAYS FROM DAY 1 BEING A TUESDAY before you write a word, and check all fifty against your own arithmetic and against `bible/power-system.md` §33B, and if your arithmetic and a table disagree your arithmetic is right.** The run was validated three times in this volume, at the start of each batch, and every time at zero mismatches, and the close should not be the phase that finds a fourth error. **A weekday on a page outranks a weekday in a plan, and a day map is a plan.**

**AND THE BARE MONTH.** It was registered with **NO STATED LENGTH** by a notary of fifty who named it on a page in Chapter 0316 and said why and the reason is hers. **It did not end inside this volume and no chapter of this volume ended it, and no chapter attached a meaning to the sixtieth, the seventieth or the eighty-fifth.** **YOU MAY NOT END IT, YOU MAY NOT GIVE IT A LENGTH, AND YOU MAY NOT LET THE CLOSE RECORD BE THE PLACE WHERE IT LOOKS LIKE IT HAS ONE.** If whatever comes next needs the end of the Bare Month on a page, **that is a thing a person does in a room, in daylight, with a date on the door, and it is the next volume's first decision and not this record's.**

## The four decisions this phase takes, and where they go

**A close phase is the only phase in this repository after an outline phase that is allowed to decide anything, and it takes four, and it writes all four in `outline/series.md` under a new heading in your own words, the way the Volume 07 close phase wrote its four and the way the Volume 08 outline phase wrote its four. Read `outline/series.md` first and match the shape exactly, including where the heading goes relative to the Volume 08 block.**

1. **THE VOICE OF THE NEXT VOLUME, confirmed or not, and if it is confirmed say so in a sentence and say what carries.** Five volumes have confirmed it: fifty-day volumes, one chapter to one day, about a page and a yard and a wage in salt, nobody gets stronger. **Add to it whatever this volume found about the shape of the sentence, and there are three findings and two of them are about instruments and not about prose.** *(a) The bolded share is a symptom and not a target: the two ends of Batch 0005's range of 5.40 to 17.97 are the volume's last image, which is objects and a road and nobody talking, and a woman on a bench being told a name she has not given away is going out of the city, and the two ends are the two ends of the two subjects and not of two qualities.** *(b) A chapter that has no speech in it at all reads as a legitimate low figure on the bolded instrument AND as a legitimate zero on the exchange instrument, and it took running the second instrument to see the first, so **two instruments that both return a number a writer expected are not two instruments, and a figure at zero deserves the same suspicion as a figure at twelve.*** *(c) The chorus frame is a sentence and not a token, and its repair is a hand job: Batch 0005's first pass came out at one instance in every 4.4 paragraphs, which is the same density as Batch 0004's first pass, and a writer told about a frame four times wrote it twice at the density the review named as a fault, and **the telling is not the instrument and the rule has to be a rule and not a warning.** Add the fourth: **a name can go at the top of a page and not be printed in the repository that printed the page, and Volume 08 did that once, on purpose, and the close has to say whether it is a decision or an accident.**
2. **THE LINE OF THE NEXT VOLUME, and it must be audited before it is adopted.** `outline/volume-08.md` §19 is the standing test and the Volume 07 close record is its model: **a line is made of words the manuscript has never used AND of things the manuscript has never seen, and a line that is only the first collides with a page that already means something else.** Volume 08's incoming line was struck for exactly that reason and four of its nouns collided, and the audit that caught them is the audit you have to run. **Run it on the chapter files and not on a state file, publish the count with the instrument, and if the line's load-bearing nouns are all in the high column of this manuscript's own vocabulary then say so, because that was the finding that made Volume 08's line work and it is the finding that will make or unmake the next one.**
3. **THE CALENDAR OF THE NEXT VOLUME, and this is the one that cannot be skipped.** **The Bare Month has no stated length and it did not end inside this volume, so the next volume begins on an unknown number of days into a month of no stated length, and that is a decision the close has to take deliberately and not by accident.** Write it in `bible/power-system.md` as a **new numbered section in the same numbered form as §33A and not as an amendment of §33A or §33B**, and say what the day numbers are, what the form is, and whether the Bare Month ends inside the next volume. **If it does, the end of it is a thing on a page in a room in daylight with a date on it by a person, and not a sentence in a state file and not a chapter that guesses, and the cost of it is to be said out loud first and refused by a person before she does it, exactly the way the Short Month and the Bare Month were both made.** **And no batch may make, amend or extend it after you write it, and the section number you take is the next free one and you take exactly one.**
4. **THE CAST, and the rule that no name and no place arrives by narration.** Volume 06's state layer broke this by naming a gatekeeper who was on no page and a review caught it, and the name is in the repository only as the record of the strike. **Decide who the next volume puts on a page and by what instrument, and say the instrument, and the instrument this repository has is the oldest one in the book: a document arrives and is read out.** **And the two descriptor debts this volume left: *about two hundred rooms* is on three men in Volume 08 and two of them share a nine in a second place, and you may settle it or you may carry it, and if you carry it you must say you are carrying it.**

## The close record: `state/volume-08-close.md`

**It does not exist. This phase creates it. Do not create a batch prompt of any kind, do not create a continuation directory, do not create a Volume 09 prompt of any kind, and do not create a review prompt. The next phase, whatever it turns out to be, is whatever you make it at the end of this run, and you make it at the end of this run and not before it.**

Every part of it is written somewhere and has to be gathered, compressed and not invented:

- **A single opening paragraph that puts a reader in the last scene of the volume**, with a day number, a weekday, a date form, an hour and a place. **Volume 08 ends on day 400, a Tuesday by the founding rule and derived from day 1 being a Tuesday, the eighty-fifth day of the Bare Month, a month with no registered length at all, at about the seventh hour of the morning at the top of a shut road: a man of about fifty-nine who has walked a four-hundred-mile road four times in nine years and has never once seen anybody on it has put his barrow down on the low side of a fence of sixteen willow posts and eleven withies bound with the same cord, and the last three of those posts went into the ground on the thirty-eighth day of that month, a Thursday, and nobody sent him and nobody is going to ask him why; a man of about fifty-seven with a length of new rope over his arm that he has never used is on the low side of that fence and has not been asked where it is and is not going to be; a man of about sixty who put the fence up has come up the road behind a handcart with a hazel mallet in it whose head is bound in the same cord and has said out loud in a lane that he has begun to want to know what his own work is for and is not going to find out; nine people went down the road at the bottom of that fence on the seventy-sixth day of that month, a Sunday, with a barrow each, and the man of about fifty-nine did not go after them; a mark in a field has no word on any page in the world and never will have one again; and the road goes on down into the low ground with three barrows on it, going away.** Nine or ten sentences. **It is the inheritance and it must be readable alone, and it must not say what the Bare Month is or how long it is or what it does at its end, and it must not attach a meaning to the eighty-fifth.**
- **§1 What Volume 08 answered.** Gather it from the five batch records and **check it against the chapters, because a batch record is a witness and not a court.** The honest answer is short and should be written short: **a form with a heading and four places under it and no place on it anywhere for the person; a fourth place found to be a household's and refused on a step before anybody asked, and going out empty and correct; a man asked what a column is for for the first time in nine years and answering, once, in his own words, and the answer not written down anywhere in this repository; a name said out loud in daylight in a room with a date on the door and written down nowhere, and then a page with that name at the top of it going out on a date, correct, about the wrong people; a man right about what a name at the top of a page does, in one turn of speech, thanked by nobody and argued with by nobody; a rule about forms refused in six words, which cost a man the whole of what his one answer had been worth; a man saying out loud on a wharf that the price of a name at the top of a page is his; one line entered in a register with a day on it and nothing under the day, and the third column left empty on purpose; a question about a fence asked to a room by a woman who has been told nothing twice and answered by nobody; three people on a four-hundred-mile road with a barrow each, a party of four is four, and the fourth not asked about anything by anybody; a page with nine places on it taken out of an apron and given to nobody; a market roof that came back up; and a fence that is the last thing anybody in that flood built.**
- **§2 What Volume 08 deliberately did not answer.** All of it, and it is not a gap: **the page a hundred and forty years old, which is not fetched, and the town four hundred miles inland, which is not entered, and the eight names at the foot of it, which are not read; the figure the man of about thirty-eight has in his head; the mark in the orchard; the word on the second slate; the day-154 sentence, which is the moral centre of the volume and is on a page in Volume 03 and Volume 04 and is not said, restated, paraphrased or improved on in any of the fifty; the question of day 346 and the question of day 396, which rhyme and are both unanswered; the fence, and whether it works; the ninth line and whether it works; the days since the fourth of the four said no; the two rolls of the same gates; the Crown's schedule, which stands and is correct and is never opened; the Regent, who is nine hundred miles away and is not defeated; the girl of seventeen; the fourth house at Nine Elms; the keeper of the Redroot gate, whose year is not named and whose days are not counted; the room at the far end of the Narrow Mark; the boards under the chapel; the island; the box; the man of about thirty-two on the bank; and the man of about thirty-seven in `chapters/volume-06/chapter-0293.md`, who is a real person on a page and is not the board-trader.**
- **§3 What is live into whatever comes next. Eight to twelve items, chosen because the next volume's plan needs them and not because they are the most interesting.** The obvious ones: **a woman's name at the top of a page that left this city and is printed in no file in this repository, which is the first time this book has spent a name and kept the copy; a mark in a field with no word on any page in the world; a fence of sixteen posts and eleven withies that two men have stood at and neither of whom has ever been asked where it is, and a question about it that went to a room and was answered by nobody; a man who has paid for half a holding and is right and is standing in front of a thing he cannot move; a line in a register with a day on it and nothing under the day, and a shelf with a slate on it with a date on it and nothing under it; a man who fills in a column in from what he is given and has a working behind the figure that has no place on the form; three of four people on a road with a barrow each; a woman of about twenty-nine with a folded page in her apron that she has taken out once in about a fortnight and given to nobody; a man who has asked one question in nine years and answered it, and what answering it cost him; the man of about thirty-nine who took a name off his own board in about the ninth year and has never said so; the keeper at a shut gate who has never been asked anything; the store's board, unwritten since day 225; and the three people who are on a road that nobody in this city can be shown one person on.** **Say in the record which items you dropped and why, because a close record that silently drops is a close record nobody can check.**
- **§4 What must not be re-litigated.** The standing prohibitions, carried and compressed: **the sixth form, *the Nth day of the Bare Month*, the Nth being day less 315, established on a page in Chapter 0316 by Sera Vail after a refusal whose reason was the refuser's, with NO LENGTH STATED, and that is the cheapest protection this volume bought and a chapter that ends a month by declaring it over has thrown it away for a small effect; NO CHAPTER MAY USE AN ORDINAL FOR A MONTH, forward-looking from day 301 and applying to every volume after this one;** that a weekday is a figure and day 1 is a Tuesday and every one of the fifty was recomputed from that; **the volume's one panel, spent on day 393, plain, in its own block, giving a rule and not an answer, refused in about four seconds in six words, on a page once and never again, and that the wall said nothing on the other forty-nine days; that the count of this city's silences is derived, on no page, in no mouth, and is 292 at day 392, 292 at day 393 because day 393 is not a silence, and 299 at day 400, and is printed in no chapter;** that a bolded speech is the only speaker marker in the manuscript, that a narrative paragraph is never in bold, **and that a speech paragraph carries one of the two or it is invisible to both instruments at once, because the exchange check counts quotation marks and the bolded check counts bold marks, and two such paragraphs stood in Chapters 0341 and 0342 until a review repair gave them the marker;** **that a set of objects named in two chapters is counted by no check in this repository, that the volume's last image is a fence of sixteen posts and eleven withies, and that a later writer may not print a count of a thing that a neighbouring chapter counts differently;** **that the day-154 sentence is not said, restated, paraphrased, improved on or put into a second mouth in any of the fifty chapters, that the man who is right about it in this volume is the man of about thirty-nine in Chapter 0393 and that is his only appearance in it, and that a chapter may put the thing on a page and let a man be right about it in about four seconds and may not say the sentence;** **and that the word on the second slate is on a page once in Chapter 0310, in narration twice in Chapter 0342, in no mouth at all, at zero in the other forty-seven files of its volume and at zero in all fifty files of this one, and no file this phase produces may print it.**
- **§5 The one thing the next phase should know about the shape of the book.** Write it in the voice of the person handing it over. **Nobody in fifty days got stronger.** Adrian Vale is Stage 2 on all fifty days, performed no working, no threshold was opened, the Narrow Mark is not opened a third time, the other world is not named once across the fifty files, nobody offered him a workway and he asked for none, and the words *passage* and *privilege* are at zero. **He is named in SEVEN of the fifty chapters — 0352, 0355, 0360, 0371, 0376, 0381 and 0392 — and in no chapter in any form in the other forty-three, and the seven are the plan's own list and not a batch's doing, and Chapter 0392 is the last of them. Write that number down and say what it is, and say that the remedy is a decision and not a repair.** The gains are **a form read out in the local language in a room with a date on the door; a fourth place identified as the one nobody can fill; a name said out loud and not written down; a page with a name at the top of it that went out correct about the wrong people; a man right about it and not thanked; a man saying out loud what a column costs; a line entered with a day on it and nothing under the day; a question asked and not answered; three people on a road; a page given to nobody; a roof; and a fence.** **None of them is a power. One of them is the price of a power. All of them are heavier than a power.** And add the two instrument findings in their own subsection, because they are the most transferable thing this volume has: **a figure at zero in an instrument a writer expected to be non-zero is the one to look at twice, and a habit that four written warnings did not remove is a rule's job and not a warning's.**
- **§6 The new question, in the volume's own words and in a mouth.** `outline/volume-08.md` §13: **who is a fence for, when the two people it stands between never agreed where it was, and neither of them has ever been asked.** It is asked once, on the eighty-first day of the Bare Month, in a room, in daylight, with a date on the door, by the woman of about sixty-nine who holds a folded sheet thirty years old in a tin, **to the room and not to anybody**, and **it is not answered, and about four of the nine people in that room had an answer and about four of them said nothing, and the answer four of them had was a fence, and the chapter says so in the next line, exactly as Chapter 0346 says it of its own question, and the two questions rhyme on purpose and neither is answered and the rhyme is not improved on.** The man of about fifty-seven and the man of about sixty were both in that room and neither of them was asked. Record that it is asked, where, by whom, in what words, and that nothing answered it.

## The one thing you have to be careful of, and it is the whole of the volume

**A reader is going to finish Chapter 0357 and turn the page, and this volume will not tell them what the answer was for, and neither will the state layer, and neither will this prompt or the handoff note. That is not an omission in the record. That is the record. It held for fifty chapters and fifty state-file appends and it has to hold through a close record too, because a close record is the one page a writer reads before planning anything, and a writer who is handed the answer in the first paragraph of the inheritance stops asking the question the volume was built on.**

**Write the record. Do not write the ending, and do not print the one sentence, and do not end the month.**
